labels.name: Myelin sheath
labels.function: Attacked in Guillain-Barre, causing ascending paralysis

labels.name: Synaptic vesicle
labels.function: Holds packets of transmitter released by exocytosis

labels.name: SNARE proteins
labels.function: Mediate exocytotic fusion; cleaved by botulinum toxin

labels.name: Voltage-gated calcium channel
labels.function: Autoantibody target in Lambert-Eaton syndrome

labels.name: Voltage-gated potassium channel
labels.function: Blocked by amifampridine to prolong depolarization

labels.name: Synaptic cleft
labels.function: Gap the transmitter diffuses across to the muscle

labels.name: Acetylcholinesterase
labels.function: Hydrolyzes the transmitter; blocked by pyridostigmine

labels.name: Nicotinic acetylcholine receptor
labels.function: Autoantibody target in myasthenia gravis

labels.name: Muscle-specific kinase
labels.function: Second antibody target tested in seronegative MG

labels.name: Motor end plate
labels.function: Complement destroys it in MG, lowering the safety factor

labels.name: Levator palpebrae superioris
labels.function: Its weakness makes the upper eyelid droop (ptosis)

labels.name: Extraocular muscles
labels.function: Weakness misaligns the eyes, causing diplopia

labels.name: Pupil
labels.function: Spared in MG (muscarinic); dilated and sluggish in botulism

labels.name: Salivary gland
labels.function: Autonomic ACh failure here causes dry mouth

labels.name: Pharyngeal muscles
labels.function: Weakness causes dysphagia

labels.name: Thymus
labels.function: Image by chest CT in MG; a tumor here is resected

labels.name: Small-cell lung carcinoma
labels.function: Paraneoplastic source of anti-VGCC antibodies

labels.name: Diaphragm
labels.function: Its failure defines a crisis needing ventilation

labels.name: Intestine
labels.function: Infant: swallowed spores colonize here and make toxin

labels.name: Proximal leg muscles
labels.function: First LES weakness: trouble rising from a chair
